decision.description: new: a new item (split into parts or not). merge: add the request to the open item in target. follow_up: a new item that builds on the open item in target. duplicate: the item in target already covers it; nothing is created.

target.description: The open item's ID (H-0042) for merge, follow_up and duplicate; an empty string for new.

parallel.description: True only for a new item that splits into parts that are truly independent: disjoint files, no ordering, each testable alone.

parts.description: Always present. When parallel is true: the 2 or more independent parts. Otherwise: an empty list.

title.description: A short imperative title, at most 60 characters.

request.description: A self-contained request for the developer who builds only this part: what to change, where, and how to check it.

paths.description: Repository-relative files, directories or globs this part touches. Parts must not share any path.
Always present. The repository-relative files, directories or globs the request's work will touch, as far as you can tell.

estimate_lines.description: Your estimate of the lines the request's work adds and removes, tests included.

reason.description: One or two sentences: why this decision, and for a split why the parts are independent.
